name: How long does it take to install a low-profile threshold?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install a low-profile threshold?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation time for a single low-profile threshold typically ranges from one to three hours for an experienced professional. This includes removing the old threshold, cleaning and preparing the subfloor, precise cutting and fitting of the new threshold, and securing it in place. More complex installations, such as those requiring significant subfloor modification or multiple thresholds, may take longer. Our team ensures efficient and high-quality work.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation usually takes 1-3 hours for a single threshold, depending on complexity and subfloor conditions.
